# lebop v0.0.9

## Changes

- Upgrade `@linear/sdk` from 95.0.0 to 99.0.0. No lebop source changes were
  required. The upstream breaking changes in 96–99 do not touch any lebop
  surface: `JiraUpdateInput.noSecret` (96), `issueImportCreateAsana`
  `asanaProjectName` (98), and `TeamUpdateInput.agentAutomationEnabled` /
  `codingAgentEnabled` (99). The SDK has been ESM-only since 97.0.0, which
  lebop's ESM build (`moduleResolution: bundler`) already supports.
- Extend the live-harness agent-session fixture gap allowlist expiry from
  2026-09-30 to 2026-12-31. The playground sandbox still has no external agent
  sessions, so the four id-based agent-session steps stay allowlisted gaps.

## Verification

- Full test suite (1414 tests), typecheck, biome, actionlint, package
  validation, and compiled-binary smoke passed on Bun 1.3.13.
- Full live CLI and MCP playground-sandbox validation was run on both
  `@linear/sdk` 95.0.0 and 99.0.0. Each run had 307 passed steps, 4 allowlisted
  agent-session gaps, and 0 failed steps, with identical step results between
  SDK versions.
- Compiled-binary (linux-x64) full live smoke passed, with strict report
  validation including binary mode and SHA-256. The discovery live smoke
  passed 24/24.
- All resources created during live validation were verified cleaned up
  (remote destructive audit 33/33).
